description:
A furniture manufacturing company needs to plan their weekly production.

The company produces two products:
1. Chairs - can be sold for $50 each
2. Tables - can be sold for $80 each

Production Constraints:
- Each chair requires 5 pounds of wood and 2 hours of labor
- Each table requires 20 pounds of wood and 6 hours of labor
- The company has 1000 pounds of wood available per week
- The company has 240 hours of labor available per week
- The company must produce at least 10 chairs per week
- The company can produce at most 30 tables per week
- Both quantities must be non-negative

Business Goal:
Maximize the total weekly profit from selling chairs and tables.

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total profit from producing chairs and tables"

constraints.description: The total wood used by chairs and tables should not exceed 1000 pounds
The total labor hours used by chairs and tables should not exceed 240 hours
The number of chairs produced should be at least 10
The number of tables produced should be at most 30

chairs.definition: The number of chairs produced per week

tables.definition: The number of tables produced per week
